ModMetaData.name: RimAI.Quests
ModMetaData.author: Laurence042
ModMetaData.description:
RimAI.Quests appends narrative context to RimWorld quests. It does not replace original quest parameters.
Features: • Shared RimAI gameplay text-AI configuration • Streaming narrative appended below the original quest text • Colony-aware context for generated backstory
Requirements: Harmony and RimAI.Communication. Configure the shared RimAI provider; this module does not own a second gameplay credential.
Attribution: derived from Laurence042 / RimTalk---Quests work under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. The live product name is RimAI.Quests.
